notes.title: NEWS - 04 - Coming to Kickstarter Soon
notes.content:
Kickstarter 

Hey there, folks! A rather unpleasant habit of not sharing much news too often, guilty of it, I've been for sure. Yet again, I'm here to make amends and explain our current situation. The goal of allocating funding to our project bore only sour fruit, which occupied the baskets of many other indie developers who are seeking funding. We spent almost two years of free nights preparing two major builds, which we felt somewhat confident to pitch to publishers, but neither shot hit the satisfactory target. Both the spirit and flesh, and our wallets, hit a significant low at which some of us had to find new jobs, unable to work on the CRAVE as much as we'd like to. 

Without going into much more detail, we decided we won't take the route of seeking a suitable publisher partner, and try an equally terrifying option of Kickstarter. We've already started to work on new stuff that we're very eager to show you. Meanwhile, take a look at a scene around which we're slowly preparing our Kickstarter trailer. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383328/363ee3e4dff507ac2bcfcb015f35f2bdee1c06c5.png"]                                                       New biome Fortune's Breast 



Rest assured that the work is not solely centered on marketing, and the work is being done on the gameplay side of things as well. Both endeavours will ultimately clash together with the launch of the Kickstarter campaign, which is gonna be accompanied by a significantly updated playable demo. 

Before we get there, we're planning to launch a pre-launch campaign page this year where we'll try to funnel all the traffic from here on Steam and other corners of the internet. Please, if you still haven't, please accept my invitation to join our Discord server to be the first to watch over the first steps of this upcoming journey ahead of us. 

Thank you for your patience, and all the love. On the other side, although quiet, it is very much appreciated. 





Cheers, 



Neker

notes.title: NEWS - 03 - Treading the Business Waters
notes.content:
Sniffing out the the right opportunities!

Hey there folks! I’m sorry about being late in keeping you up with current CRAVE affairs. These past two months were a rather strange experience as I was leaning heavily on the business side of things. Prepping pitches for publishers, scrutinizing budget sheets, and actively wearing the skin of someone who not only knows what he is doing but also looks like he knows what he is doing. You see, there is a big difference. I consider myself as someone who’d rather have his work speak for himself. But if I’ve learned anything from all this, you are most of all pitching you, your team, and your overall ability to deliver on your game vision.

It took me a few meetings to realize this.

Honestly, with this update, I was hoping to bring you the good news. However, we still haven’t acquired funding for the full development of CRAVE. These things take time, and we’re already lighting the candle from both sides as our day job chores grind us down, while we try to work on the game during the nights. 

Speaking of this, I thought I had a solid hypothesis. I’ve explained to the publishers that our demo is a result of working on the game in our free time, expecting them to imagine how awesome and amazing it would be if we could sink our teeth into it. Apart from two meetings, this came off as a red flag. Like we’re not even fully committed to the project. I was baffled. Yet, I realized that there is some truth to it. So I’ve decided to quit my current day job. In one month I will be fully focusing on CRAVE. 

No pressure.  

Nevertheless, I try to look at these situations as necessary prep work which allows me to wear the business skin more comfortably. By this I mean, talk confidently about our game, our team, and me myself being in the game industry for 15 years. I’m sure we’d be able to sniff out a proper deal that would allow us to make the game we want. And hopefully in a comforting manner. Hopefully next update I can come up with such news.

I'll leave the room on a nice note. I'm adding a few photos from the teambuilding we had last month in the beautiful hill area around Czech Pernštejn castle. We had everything, a dog, two kids, super solid folks, let me tell you. I'm just really looking forward to working with these amazing people on a more regular basis as we secure the funding for the project. One day!

Lastly, just wanted to remind anyone who is not already at our Discord, please accept my invitation again. 

Now, that's everything I guess. If you have any more questions, go ahead and hit me at the Discord. Let's talk soon! 


Cheers 

Neker

notes.title: First public demo!
notes.content:
Long time no see!

[strike]Dobro jutro[/strike], I mean hello friends!. Last week I got the chance to attend one of the, if not my most favorite game events out there. Situated in Dubrovnik's coastal area, Reboot's atmosphere and vibes are borderline amazing. I'd also like to give a shoutout to the organizers, as I have at least half an idea of how complex and difficult is to pull off an event of such magnitude. A very special mention goes to Leo Tot who took very good care of the indie developers. And even more special thanks goes to Slovak Games Developers Association, and Slovak Art Council for allowing us to attend. 

Indie Expo

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383328/aae15f9b6e54cafb3ee93bb0ea5f206774614927.png

We presented our demo for the first time! That's right, a small playable portion of CRAVE was playable at the event's indie zone. I felt that the game resonated very well with people, lots of hands were circling around our table, trying to play the build. I was very happy with how people reacted to the overall feel of controls and the fluidity of the main character animations.  

More importantly, even mostly without the audio, and despite some janky parts of the build, almost everyone got to the end of it. Immersion-wise, the player's curiosity of what's behind the next screen, or this wall, or up above this platform was mesmerizing to watch. 

The biggest takeaways however are the ones we have to heavily focus on. I had the pleasure to write down several lines of feedback from other developers in terms of pacing, level design, tutorilization of mechanics, and much more. Improving on these fronts along additional layers of polish to combat is our main mission right now , as we move forward.

A Demo?!

Yes. If you're on our Discord server, you've heard me talking about a playable demo. If you're not there, then hey, please accept my invitation again. 
After we polish the current build and implement all the feedback I'd like to put out the playable build to anyone who's on our Discord. Perhaps with an itch.io page? Not sure how and when, but that's the idea at the moment.  

A business?!

Of course, I almost forgot. I also talked to some people who were interested in doing business at Reboot with us. We exchanged emails and see if we can find a mutual agreement on what such business should bear fruit to. I'm actually planning to do the same at the Krakow Digital Dragons event, later in May. We'll see how it goes. 

That's about it folks! It's less about words than doing actual work on the game, so take care and we'll talk again after the next note-worthy milestone. 

Cheers 

Neker

notes.title: NEWS - 01
notes.content:
Hey Folks!

Work is steady and at a satisfying pace at the moment. There is currently 6 pair of hands that are working on the game in their spare time. Despite these trying times and most of our energy being spent at our day jobs, we're excited to continue our work on this particular thing we're crumpling in our pockets. 

Discord

To avoid common pitfalls of this already bewildering endeavor of creating games, we'd like to take out our hands from those pockets as much as we can and invite you to join our Discord!  . Join us if you like to watch us at the wheel with our sleeves turned up, or if you'd prefer just a casual ramble. We're good with both.

Website

With help from our amazing friend Yablko, we even now have a website. Little too soon you might ask? Perhaps, but I believe we might score some extra fashion points at the publishing goalkeepers. 

Current Status

Which leads us to the kicker, really. Our work on the demo continues as we're approaching the point in development where we'd like to start thinking out loud about the manners of funding the whole project. Whether it's a pursuit of the right publisher or something else, we do not know yet. Be sure though we'll keep you updated if anything interesting comes up. 

Meanwhile, you might to check a short time-lapse of our art direction of the new game area.

[previewyoutube=r09yLvewtjw;full][/previewyoutube]


Freebies!

Everyone loves snacks. I thought many people love fancy phone backgrounds. If you agree, you can download one which captures one area in the game. Viaduct. I'm sorry it's all this kitchen has to offer right now. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42383328/991a4b19883cafb9a5f3e78427702acc3125ea8f.jpg


That would be all I suppose. Love to talk like this. Let's do that more often! 

Take care! 

Neker
